$comment: Screen registry. Every screen gets an entry keyed by screen name: generator-backed screens carry id + sourceScreen (the generator's identifiers) and the generator's canvas width/height; hand-authored screens set id/sourceScreen null and localOnly true. Every in-place revision sets supersedes to the replaced id and says why in note. A screen with no entry does not exist.
